open_points.subject: FlowActivation creation for proven read-only flow (M18 vs State 0 activate action)
open_points.text: K-08: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven"; Primary actions: "activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once"; M18 source: "The kernel, after proof and, for effectful versions, the owner."
open_points.question: For a proven read-only flow version, is a FlowActivation created automatically at compose/prove time, or only when an activate action is called?
options: Automatic activation immediately when proof is proven
Activation only on explicit activate request (agent or owner)
Both paths allowed (auto on proof, plus explicit re-activation)
open_points.default_guess: Activation only on explicit activate request, because activation is listed as a primary action with explicit refusal rules.

open_points.subject: EffectAttempt resend authority after owner resolves `unknown` as `not_applied` for `draft-write`
open_points.text: K-08: "A draft-write runs under the owner's activation of the flow instead" and "An effect resolved as not applied is sent again only with a fresh approval"; M26 authority: "the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send the flow activation"; M26 lifecycle: "Sending again after `not_applied` is a new attempt under a fresh approval, never under a standing approval."
open_points.question: If a `draft-write` attempt is resolved `not_applied`, what authority must a resend use?
options: Require a fresh per-attempt owner approval even for `draft-write`
Resend under flow activation authority (no per-attempt approval for `draft-write`)
Do not resend `draft-write` after `not_applied` (run must fail/refuse)
open_points.default_guess: Resend under flow activation authority, interpreting the fresh-approval rule as applying only to classes that normally require approval.
